source_title: Motherwell fan views on 2-2 draw with St Johnstone - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your opinions after Motherwell's winless run extended to seven games with a 2-2 draw against St Johnstone.
Matthew : Everything about this team suggests relegation.
Crawford : We dominated the game from the outset then lost an avoidable goal, but we didn't buckle and improved noticeably with the introduction of Lukas Fadinger and Kanga. Hopefully Tawanda Maswanhise can press on now but we still lack depth in central defence and we're paying the price every game.
Taylor : Must-win game and of course we lose an equaliser at the death, yet again with some poor defending. Alfred Johansson is severely out his depth and taking a football club which experienced joy last season and turning us into a fan base that are now dreading games. I decided not to attend the game and won't be attending forthcoming away games while Johansson is still at the helm.
Del : No disrespect to St Johnstone but they are the type of team we should be beating. Performance wise, most of it was pretty decent and we dominated for large spells. Once again, shocking defending from bang-average players who can't jump is our undoing. I also have to question why we take Maswanhise off to put on a central defender? We should be keeping all our main attacking threats on the pitch and going for more goals. The St Mirren game is huge and must win on Saturday now.
Stuart : A real gut punch. We play good football but don't capitalise when on top. We sit back late on when we know we can't defend high balls into the box and if you don't then stop the crosses at source your luck will eventually run out. As always with Motherwell, it's the hope that kills you.
